lines.text: Jesus traveled throughout Galilee and avoided Judea because the Jews there were trying to kill Him, though the Feast of Tabernacles was near.
His brothers told Him to go to Judea so that His disciples there could see His works, yet they did not believe in Him.
Jesus told His brothers that the world hates Him because He testifies that its works are evil, and that they should go up alone.
Jesus stayed in Galilee, but after His brothers went up to the feast, He also went, riding in on a young donkey.

wrong_details.wrong: riding in on a young donkey

lines.text: At the feast the Jews looked for Him, and some said He is a good man while others said He breaks the Sabbath.
